lines.zh: 我用根须拖着身子挪动。
lines.en: I pull myself along on my roots.
The crown on my head sways.
I push out through the bamboo.

lines.zh: 我的叶片在地上刮出声。
lines.en: My leaves rasp on the ground.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地朝有动静的地方去。
lines.en: I move slowly toward any sound.

lines.zh: 我的根部留下一道湿痕。
lines.en: My roots leave a damp trail.
I go around a clump of low bamboo.

lines.zh: 我把花冠抬起来，朝着光。
lines.en: I lift my bloom toward the light.

lines.zh: 根须挪一寸，我再停一停。
lines.en: My roots shift an inch, then pause.

lines.zh: 我的花心里有东西在动。
lines.en: Something moves inside my bloom.
I follow the line of a vine.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地挪到林子边上。
lines.en: I shift slowly to the forest's edge.

lines.zh: 我的根扎下去，又拔起来。
lines.en: My roots sink, then lift again.

lines.zh: 我在阴影里移动得最快。
lines.en: I move fastest in shadow.

lines.zh: 我用叶子扫开落下的枯枝。
lines.en: I sweep the fallen twigs aside with a leaf.
I head for the warmer ground.

lines.zh: 我立在竹林里，像一株花。
lines.en: I stand among the bamboo like a flower.

lines.zh: 我的花冠慢慢张开又合上。
lines.en: My bloom opens and closes slowly.
I wait for insects to fly near.

lines.zh: 湿气从我的根部渗出去。
lines.en: Damp seeps out around my roots.

lines.zh: 阳光从叶缝里落在我身上。
lines.en: Sun falls on me through the leaves.

lines.zh: 我的花心发出一股甜味。
lines.en: My bloom gives off a sweetness.

lines.zh: 有只蝶落在我边上，飞走了。
lines.en: A butterfly lands nearby and flies off.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地摇摆，像被风吹。
lines.en: I sway slowly, as if by wind.

lines.zh: 我在听林子里有没有脚步。
lines.en: I listen for footsteps in the woods.
My leaves are covered in fine hairs.

lines.zh: 竹林里，我像一株真的花。
lines.en: In the bamboo, I look like a real flower.
I push my roots down a little.
Your sweat smells sweeter than rotting leaves.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地把花冠转过来。
lines.en: I turn my bloom toward you slowly.
I'm no flower of the bamboo grove.
Your boot is on my roots.
There are eyes inside my bloom.
Smell it. Sweet, isn't it?
The closer you come, the happier I am.
I've held this grove a long time.
Don't stand in my shadow.
I raise my head; I'm a little shorter than you.
A leaf is torn from me.
My bloom is crooked.
Sticky sap bleeds from the break.
I shrink back into the bamboo.

lines.zh: 竹林里，我张开的就是嘴。
lines.en: In the bamboo, what I open is a mouth.
I sway twice and hold my ground.

lines.zh: 这一下让我的花心缩了。
lines.en: That made my bloom's heart shrink.
Dust on me. I can't breathe.
You cut deeper than I thought.
I need to root somewhere else.
Something's moving near me.
You've set your pack down.
The sweetness draws it over.
I open my leaves slowly.
That much noise is just right.

lines.zh: 我朝着你的方向倾过去。
lines.en: I lean toward you.

lines.zh: 我的根须伸到你的脚边。
lines.en: My roots reach your feet.
What are you looking at down there?
I stop and wait for you to come closer.
This smells better than insects.
You hit me and my leaves rustle loud.
I shift my roots aside.
My bloom brushes your shoulder.
Don't push; my roots are shallow.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，花粉飞了一片。
lines.en: We collide and pollen flies.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的根尖，我缩了。
lines.en: You step on a root tip and I pull it in.
I move aside, and the vines follow.
That left me tilted half a foot.
You're against me enough to smell the sweetness.
I withdraw slowly into the bamboo.

lines.zh: 另一朵花从竹丛里探出来。
lines.en: Another bloom leans out of the bamboo.
Our blooms face each other.
Its bloom's heart is deeper than mine.
Pollen drifts in the space between us.
Our stems twist tight among the leaves.
Its roots twine round mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起朝着有光的地方。
lines.en: Together we turn toward the light.
In the bamboo grove, only the two of us.
The soil here is rich enough.
Next year this grove will be fuller.

lines.zh: 我用叶片卷起一块东西。
lines.en: I curl a leaf around something.
This one is still warm.
I bring it into my bloom's heart.
So small I nearly lost it.
I wrap it with my roots.
This one is somewhat sweet.
I press it under the soil.
It's mine. Don't stoop for it.
I take it in slowly.
This cloth will cover my roots.

lines.zh: 我用根须拖着身子从竹林挤出来。
lines.en: I haul myself out of the bamboo on my roots.
Something moved close to me.
My bloom has opened fully.
The sweetness grows stronger.
My roots spread over the ground.
You've backed deep into the bamboo.
A bamboo-grove flytrap with a wide mouth.

lines.zh: 我的叶片一片片立起来。
lines.en: My leaves stand up one by one.
My petals close into a mouth.
The light is dim here. Perfect.

lines.zh: 我的根须已经围住你了。
lines.en: My roots have closed around you.
This time I'm done pretending to be a flower.
I follow along your tracks.
Bamboo leaves stir and I know.

lines.zh: 我把根须铺到你的路上。
lines.en: I lay my roots across your path.

lines.zh: 你身上的甜味一直跟着。
lines.en: That sweetness on you stays with me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地收紧周围的藤。
lines.en: I slowly tighten the surrounding vines.
You're heading deeper into the woods.

lines.zh: 这里每一根竹子都是我的。
lines.en: Every bamboo here is mine.

lines.zh: 藤蔓伸到你脚边，还差一寸。
lines.en: My vine reaches your feet, one inch short.

lines.zh: 我张开一片叶子，又合上。
lines.en: I open a leaf, then close it.
Don't look back; it won't help.
I spread slowly around you.

lines.zh: 我听见你的呼吸了，食虫花也听见。
lines.en: I hear your breath, and so does this insect-eating bloom.

lines.zh: 我的叶片从你手背划过。
lines.en: My leaf slices across your hand.
I bite down on your wrist.
That one came with a hint of sweetness.
My roots trip your feet.
You pull back and bamboo leaves fall.
I drag you into the bamboo.
My bloom has opened wide.

lines.zh: 竹林里我张开花瓣，等你伸手。
lines.en: In the bamboo I open my petals for your hand.
I let go and retreat into the shade.
The bud closes, and juice drips down.
A flower opens deep in the bamboo.
A small damp patch appears on the ground.

lines.zh: 我的花冠从叶子里探出来。
lines.en: My bloom pushes out of the leaves.
This flower wasn't here before.
My roots enter the soil first.

lines.zh: 风把甜味带到整片林子。
lines.en: The wind carries sweetness through the woods.

lines.zh: 我在竹子的影子里站住了。
lines.en: I settle in the bamboo's shadow.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地张开第一片叶。
lines.en: I unfold my first leaf slowly.
Something is moving in the bamboo.
I raise my head, bloom to the sky.

lines.zh: 火一燎，我的叶片就卷了。
lines.en: Fire touches me and my leaves curl.

lines.zh: 我从竹子上掉下来，摔散了。
lines.en: I drop from the bamboo and come apart.
Water covers my crown and I can't breathe.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的叶子全掀掉。
lines.en: The blast strips all my leaves.
An arrow goes through my stem.

lines.zh: 法术扫过，我的花瓣卷曲。
lines.en: The spell sweeps past and my petals curl.
There's no nourishment in this soil.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整株都焦了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and I'm scorched whole.

lines.zh: 虚空把我的根从土里拔出来。
lines.en: The void pulls my roots out of the earth.
